verdict.rationale: Flagright documents business users as a first-class entity (batch create and get business-user endpoints) and markets watchlist screening and dynamic risk scoring, so screening business entities is plausibly supported. Nothing in the pack shows ownership, beneficial-owner, or association linkage, or a way to inspect linked risk context. missing for 10: explicit evidence that watchlist screening applies to business entities, ownership/UBO or association data model, linked-entity risk context view, screening result detail, independent corroboration.
